args.lesson: STOP paid packaging. Reading all 64 posts, not just 20, reversed the earlier PURSUE_IF. Rowpatch does a different job, but itsallsame offers a live free equivalent. The only agency participant declined a USD19 pilot (post 59). At least 10 posters were vendors and no purchase was seen. Next time read the whole thread and count vendor vs buyer voices before building. A vendor-proposed price that a participant echoes is not willingness to pay. Keep the prototype free.
